What's your warranty policy on defective items?
We offer a 90-day manufacturer’s warranty for items bought directly from us. If an item has a manufacturing defect, arrives damaged, or has a part break during assembly, we can replace the affected item or part free of charge under the warranty. Damage caused by misuse or negligence isn’t covered; items bought from third-party sellers are subject to those sellers’ policies.
You can read the details and submit a claim on our warranty page.
